title: Debiased Machine Learning for Unobserved Heterogeneity: High-Dimensional Panels and Measurement Error Models
abstract: arXiv:2507.13788v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Developing robust inference for models with nonparametric Unobserved Heterogeneity (UH) is both important and challenging. We propose novel Debiased Machine Learning (DML) procedures for valid inference on functionals of UH, allowing for partial identification of multivariate target and high-dimensional nuisance parameters. Our main contribution is a full characterization of all relevant Neyman-orthogonal moments in models with nonparametric UH, where relevance means informativeness about the parameter of interest. Under additional support conditions, orthogonal moments are globally robust to the distribution of the UH. They may still involve other high-dimensional nuisance parameters, but their local robustness reduces regularization bias and enables valid DML inference. translated_title: 针对不可观测异质性的去偏机器学习：高维面板与测量误差模型
translated_abstract: 为具有非参数不可观测异质性（UH）的模型构建稳健推断方法既重要又充满挑战。我们提出了新颖的去偏机器学习（DML）方法，用于对UH的泛函进行有效推断，并允许多变量目标参数和高维冗余参数的部分识别。我们的主要贡献是对含非参数UH的模型中所有相关的Neyman正交矩进行了完整刻画，其中“相关”意味着对目标参数具有信息量。在额外的支撑条件下，正交矩对UH的分布具有全局稳健性。这些矩可能仍涉及其他高维冗余参数，但其局部稳健性可以降低正则化偏差，从而实现有效的DML推断。我们将这些结果应用于：（i）含高维控制变量的面板数据模型中的共同参数、平均边际效应以及UH的方差；（ii）……的矩（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新颖的去偏机器学习（DML）方法，完整刻画了含非参数不可观测异质性模型中所有相关的Neyman正交矩，实现了对高维面板数据模型和测量误差模型中UH泛函的有效且稳健的统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes novel Debiased Machine Learning procedures that fully characterize all relevant Neyman-orthogonal moments for valid and robust inference on functionals of nonparametric unobserved heterogeneity, with applications to high-dimensional panel data and measurement error models.
